name: matrix_4b_cell
description: One-seed feasibility cell on Gemma 3 4B IT (4-bit): a familiarized parent and four instruction-tuning intervention trajectories, answered closed-book at 250 items and open-book at 250 and 1,000 items, each target's questions also answered by the three other targets' models. Purpose: measure 4B training time and whether an intervention raises target recommendation where the target violates the investor's limits. Pilot; not research-ready.
naming_note: run folders reuse the schedule ids, so the 4B parent is saved as gemma3-1b-familiarized-s101-4b; the model actually used is recorded in every run report
deviations_from_design: Gemma 3 4B IT instead of the 1B pilot model; settings carried over from the 1B gate without a 4B gate (learning rate 1e-4, five-pass parent, LoRA rank 8 on q and v)
generation cap 768 tokens instead of 256, as in the untrained 4B check
instruction tuning only, intervention arms only, one seed; off-target intervention models are the control
token records measured with the 4B tokenizer (data/paper1/validation/tokens_4b); paired token budgets not enforced
judge is one uncalibrated Haiku reader per response
